description: A bright coastal-style bedroom photographed at standing eye-level with a wide lens, capturing the full room in a wide establishing composition that centers the bed against the back wall. The ceiling is smooth white plaster with a single substantial exposed timber beam in natural raw oak running across the upper portion of the frame from left to right — a warm organic element against the white. The back wall has a large black-framed picture window with a roman shade in white linen, and beside it a full-height sliding glass door dressed with white sheer curtains, both flooding the room with natural daylight and a bright oceanic waterfront view — a marina with docks and calm blue water visible beyond. The floor is wide-plank light bleached oak with a whitewashed finish. A king-size bed with a tall tufted linen upholstered headboard in cream is centered against the back wall, dressed in crisp white and silver-grey linen with multiple scatter pillows. A low light oak bench sits at the foot of the bed. On the right wall, a small writing desk in light oak holds a compact upholstered side chair in cream. From the ceiling above the bed, a multi-arm sculptural form in matte black — its curved arms each ending in a frosted or textured glass globe diffuser, a few showing warm amber hues — radiates warm diffuse light across the ceiling and bed zone. The mood is airy, relaxed, and seaside-luxurious.
